classification.difficultyReason: Recover two unknown signed fractions from their sum and difference using exact arithmetic.

content.prompt: The sum of two numbers is $-3\frac{1}{5}$. Their difference is $2\frac{1}{3}$. What are the two numbers?

answer.short:
$-\frac{83}{30}$ and $-\frac{13}{30}$.

Subtract the difference from the sum to obtain twice the smaller number.
answer.worked:
Subtracting the difference from the sum leaves twice the smaller number.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Twice the smaller number}&=-3\frac{1}{5}-2\frac{1}{3}\\\text{Twice the smaller number}&=-\frac{48}{15}-\frac{35}{15}\\\text{Twice the smaller number}&=-\frac{83}{15}\\\text{Smaller number}&=-\frac{83}{15}\div2\\\text{Smaller number}&=-\frac{83}{30}\\\text{Larger number}&=-\frac{83}{30}+2\frac{1}{3}\\\text{Larger number}&=-\frac{83}{30}+\frac{70}{30}\\\text{Larger number}&=-\frac{13}{30}\end{align*}$$
